limitations: Cold profiles include startup long tasks; use the first pointer_event duration for cold-picking comparison, not the maximum startup task.
Downloads and automation calls took variable wall time. The numbers are in-application handler spans and browser Long Tasks observations, not tool-call duration.
Single desktop host, fixed viewport and fixture; no universal worst-case guarantee.
Final before/after profiles were captured after compilation completed. Other desktop activity was not controlled.

The final build adds position-table preallocation and mesh/inference opt-level=3. Its profile download could not be retrieved through browser automation; 141.6 to 75.2 ms and the zero-long-task Select All result compare baseline with the intermediate structural fix, not a measured final-build speedup.
gui_checks: All 216,000 eligible elements selected. Intermediate skin completed as 36 extra meshes and editor returned to idle.
Replacing the whole selection with one element removed all 36 highlight meshes; no stale skin or console errors.
Exact timing of cancellation during a pending batch is covered by unit tests, not inferred from these cursor timings.

Final optimized build: 216,000 selected, 331 mesh entities after completion, then 1 selected and 295 entities after replacement; no console errors. Final profile download unavailable, but editor remained responsive.
